one_line: Show the blank shirt becoming a finished one, step by step, and end with a child wearing it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a hand holds a Giotto Decor Textile marker pack at an angle on a wooden table; at 0:01 a marker is pulled out. No speech. Colourful cut-out letters assemble near the bottom into: "מכינים חולצות ליום הראשון ללימודים".
q1_hook.why: A dated promise, shirts for the first day of school, and the product in hand from the first frame (H1, H2, S1). The brand pack with its logo fills the frame for about 3 s, a heavy start (H3). No face or voice (against H4), and the text sits low (T4).

beats.what: The marker pack, a marker pulled out; the title letters assemble
beats.why: Season and product named at once

beats.what: A hand outlines "שלום כיתה" in black on a T-shirt; box "מציירים על חולצה עם הטושים לטקסטיל"
Child and adult hands colour the letters; box "של GIOTTO" to 0:09
beats.why: The colour appears letter by letter, a visible change

beats.what: Yellow stars are drawn around the words
The finished shirt with the pack beside it
beats.why: The result and the brand again, with no text

beats.what: Ironing the back of the shirt; box "כדי לקבע עוברים עם מגהץ"
beats.why: Answers whether the print will last

beats.what: A child, face out of frame, in a black shirt, then the decorated one; print close-up
beats.why: The shirt is worn, which is the payoff

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none in the video. The caption opens with a rhetorical question, "רוצים שהילדים שלכם יהיו הכי מיוחדים ביום הראשון ללימודים???".
q2_flow.why: A clear blank-to-finished arc with a new step every 3 to 4 s keeps the story moving (K2, R3), and the child wearing the shirt in the last 5 s is the payoff (R4, K1). The 10 s of colouring and 4 s of stars have no text, so the middle leans on the pictures (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: no ask; it ends "אז קדימה, שנת הלימודים עוד מעט מתחילה" and "בשיתוף @giotto_israel". No link, store or code.
q3_cta.why: A viewer who wants the markers gets no shop, link or word to act on, so interest cannot turn into action (against C6, C7). "אז קדימה" nudges but names no action.

q4_shown.what: The marker pack 0:00-0:02 and 0:19-0:20; top-down hands outlining, colouring and adding stars on a white T-shirt 0:03-0:18; ironing the back 0:21-0:24; a child, face out of frame, in a black shirt and then the decorated one 0:25-0:29. No price.
q4_shown.why: Blank shirt to a finished shirt worn by a child is a clear before and after (R4, K2). The iron step answers a doubt about the print lasting, while the wash claim stays in the caption (K4). The brand is on screen about a quarter of the Reel, as pack and label (C7).

q5_edit.what: About 10 shots in 29.7 s (about 3 s each), clean cuts: a handheld pack shot, static top-down making shots, a static medium shot of the child. Colouring may be sped up (not verified). Step boxes at 0:04-0:06, 0:07-0:09 and 0:21-0:23 only. No speech.
q5_edit.why: A new step every 3 to 4 s with the reveal in the last 5 s keeps a simple Reel moving (E2, R4). Short step boxes suit sound off (T1, T2), but none cover 0:10-0:20 or 0:24-0:29. It ends on the print with no ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A back-to-school craft: decorating a white T-shirt with fabric markers for the first day of school; it serves parents who want a special, low-cost first-day idea.
q6_topic.why: A dated milestone parents plan for (K7, K6), with a craft that is easy to copy and save (R7). The caption's "הכי מיוחדים" is a hype phrase, against K6, but the Reel itself shows rather than claims.

q7_filmed.what: A handheld close-up of the pack on a wooden table; static top-down shots of a white shirt with adult and child hands in soft light; a top-down ironing shot; a front shot of a child against a wall, neck down; a print close-up.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands show each step and put the viewer in the maker's seat (F5, S4). The neck-down framing keeps the child's face out (S5). Even indoor light looks homemade and sharp (F7, H8). The first pack shot crops the box at the frame edge (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:02 colourful cut-out lettering that assembles, about 78 to 87 percent down: "מכינים חולצות ליום הראשון ללימודים". White text in black rounded boxes, 2 lines, about 80 to 90 percent down: "מציירים על חולצה עם הטושים לטקסטיל" (0:04-0:06), "של GIOTTO" (0:07-0:09), "כדי לקבע עוברים עם מגהץ" (0:21-0:23). No text 0:10-0:20 or 0:24-0:29.
q8_text.caption: "רוצים שהילדים שלכם יהיו הכי מיוחדים ביום הראשון ללימודים???". About 41 words in 6 short lines: the question, the markers, ironing, washing to 40 degrees, a nudge, then "בשיתוף @giotto_israel". No hashtags, no ask.
q8_text.why: The title names the seasonal topic in the first second (T3), but it and the step boxes sit in the bottom 35% (T4), and three boxes cover little of 30 s (T2). The caption's first line is a hooky question with search words but no hashtags (T7); the disclosure is in the last line (T8).

weak_points: The brand pack fills the first 3 s; no ask or place to buy; step boxes only part of the Reel and low in the frame; the disclosure in the caption's last line; the wash claim is not shown.
lumebook_takeaway: Film a blank-to-finished sequence from above, then end on the finished item in use. For LumeBook that is the book opening to the name page, with a child's hands only.
not_verified: Whether the colouring is sped up; who made the Reel; music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech). That the ironing is on the back is inferred from the mirrored print. Price, and how the caption's last line displays before "more". Correction: the title letters assemble from scattered pieces during 0:00-0:01, so the first frame has only partly formed text.
